run_f_gold: run f_gold to calculate the minimum cost to balance parentheses in a string
test_f_gold: test f_gold with balanced and unbalanced parenthesis strings to verify correct cost calculation
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return a tuple with cost and balance array instead of just cost
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty strings or strings with no parentheses
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes minimum parenthesis balancing cost using a running balance approach
